title: Reactivating a rep does not put them back on their customers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-C} as its one sales representative; customer {Customer-B} shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A}, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B} and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Other.
  • Starting screen: Settings > Staff is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Start deactivating {Sales-rep-C}'s account.
  2. Confirm the deactivation.
  3. Reactivate {Sales-rep-C}'s account.
  4. Open {Customer-A}'s page.
  5. Open {Customer-B}'s page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Deactivate window opens.
  • Step 2: {Sales-rep-C} is deactivated.
  • Step 3: {Sales-rep-C}'s account is active again.
  • Step 4: {Customer-A}'s "Sales Representative" reads "Unassigned"; {Sales-rep-C} has not been put back.
  • Step 5: {Customer-B} shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B}, with no Part Sales field; {Sales-rep-C} has not been put back.

The Sales By Representative spec, version 28 (12 Oct 2026, Story 13), says reactivating brings a person back to their customers. Chris Ward ruled on 19 Oct 2026 that they are not put back (answer 12, quoted below); this case follows PRD version 10.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R20: “Deactivating a staff member's account removes them from every customer field they hold. The customer's other fields keep their people. A Part Sales field where they were picked is removed, so new part sales follow again (S4-R26). Reactivating the account does not put them back.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 12: “12. (a) as the feature spec: removed from every customer field they hold, not put back on reactivation. New warning line: "They will be removed as sales representative from {n} customers."”
